responsibility: Provides forward declarations for essentially all Rust AST classes across the module’s subheaders (`rust-ast`, `rust-path`, `rust-expr`, `rust-item`, `rust-macro`, `rust-pattern`, `rust-stmt`, and `rust-type`). Its role is compile-time dependency management: other interfaces such as visitors can refer to the complete AST surface without including every full definition, reducing header coupling while preserving a unified type vocabulary for the Rust frontend AST.
